name: 黃秀英
objective:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
Pre-requisite: 3001011 or approved by the course instructor. 
Course Contents: Force, mass, and acceleration, particle kinematics, particle dynamics, work and energy, impulse and momentum, rigid body motion, and dynamics of the rigid body system.
General applications, vehicle dynamics, and railway vehicles will be introduced, such as basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics, wheel-rail coupling, railway vehicle climbing and slipping, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics and resistance of railway vehicles, railway vehicle braking, and applications of railway vehicles.
This course can be counted for credits if pursuing a micro-program in railway vehicles.
The course is based on 16 + 2 weeks of flexible learning.
課程進度(1-16週):
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)(Monday 17:10-19:00, Tuesday 08:10-09:00)
Week    Topics
1)     Syllabus & Introduction to Dynamics
2)     Kinematics of Particles: Rectilinear & Curvilinear Motions
3)     Kinetics of Particles: Newton’s Second Law (Examples: basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics)
4)     Kinetics of Particles: Newton’s Second Law (Examples: wheel-rail coupled, railway vehicle climbing and slipping) 
5)     Kinetics of Particles: Energy and Momentum Methods
6)     Kinetics of Particles: Energy and Momentum Methods
7)     Kinetics of Particles: Energy and Momentum Methods &
Systems of Particles
8)     Systems of Particles
9)     Midterm Exam
10)    Kinematics of Rigid Bodies (Examples: aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics, and resistance)
11)    Kinematics of Rigid Bodies
12)    Kinematics of Rigid Bodies & Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies
13)    Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies: Forces and Accelerations (Examples: railway braking, and some applications of railway vehicles)
14)    Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies: Energy and Momentum Methods
15)    Plane Motion of Rigid Bodies: Energy and Momentum Methods, Kinetics of Rigid Bodies in Three Dimensions
16)    Final Exam
17)    Flexible Independent Learning
18)    Flexible Independent Learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與校內外活動 (講座、工作坊、參訪) 或競賽 (Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Weeks 17 & 18 are scheduled as flexible independent learning. You would need to form a group of 3-4, use what you have learned in the semester, and combine with an AI tool to solve a problem.
1.	Form a group of 3-4
2.	Use AI to solve the problem
3.	Write your report with “Given”, “Find”, and “SOL”
4.	Write your report by hand. No computer output report is allowed
5.	Everyone turns in their own report to the e-Learning system.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          The goal is to understand the course content. Students may use an AI tool to solve the problem and gain a comprehensive understanding of the problem while learning through the exercise.

Every individual needs to turn in their own report. No report, no points.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Week 17 & 18 Report: 7%

Every individual needs to turn in their own report. No report, no points.
Handwritten report only.
A computer-written report will get 0 points.

scorePolicy:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
1.	Quiz (平常考)：15 % (in general, will be held on almost every Monday)
2.	Midterm Exam (期中考)：25 % 
3.	Final Exam (期末考)：30 %
4.	Homework/Vocabulary/Pre-class study (作業)：15%
5.     Week 17 & 18 Report: 7%
6.	In-class discussion, group discussion, participation, attendance (上課答問、分組討論、出席率): 8 %
7.	Homework is due the following Monday. You would need to upload your homework to the i-School before the class starts. No late homework will be accepted except having approved absences (作業上課前交，上傳 i- 學園，無遲交作業除非有正式假單)。
8.	Copying and cheating are not allowed. 0 points will be given for all involved parties if copying or cheating is found (嚴禁抄襲，抄襲者 0 分)。
9.	Please turn off your cell phone, or set your phone to silent mode; otherwise, 5 points will be deducted from the semester score and treated as one absence for each violation (上課中，手機請關機或以振動方式收訊。違者警告並記矌課一次且學期成績扣 5 分)。
10.	Attendance check will be done every week. Please sit in a fixed seat (依規定，每次上課點名，請固定座位上課。)
